summary: The episode discusses the upcoming earnings season with Sandvik as first out at all-time highs, which is seen as concerning. The gambling sector continues to struggle after regulation, with Swedish revenue down 20% for LeoVegas. Easter effect will benefit most companies with extra billing days except ICA, Cloetta, and Skistar. Investment company comparison shows Creades performing better than Öresund. Construction and real estate sectors face challenges with several companies recommended to avoid. Nent is seen as potentially undervalued.
key_takeaways: Sandvik at all-time highs before earnings is concerning, potential short opportunity
Swedish gambling revenue down significantly post-regulation, but some stocks at attractive levels
Easter falls in Q2 this year vs Q1 last year, creating easy comparisons for most companies except seasonal ones
Creades outperforming Öresund with 8.8% portfolio value increase vs 2.2% decline
Construction and real estate sectors under pressure with several stocks to avoid
Nent trading at P/E 12 with 3% dividend yield, potentially undervalued
